meta.title: Primordial Paradox music recipes, Capcom NES rock family (Mega Man 1 to 6, Ninja Gaiden, DuckTales)
meta.citation_note: Every recipe cites source ids from knowledge/music-styles/capcom.md section 13. Full titles, URLs and read dates live there, not here, because this directory is scanned by the project's clean-room gate.
meta.chip: NES 2A03 (2 pulse, triangle, noise, DPCM). Capcom's own releases used no expansion audio; CAP-29 is our arranger's VRC6 extension and is marked as such

conventions.frames: one frame is 1/60 s (16.7 ms) on NTSC; at 150 bpm a beat is 24 frames, an eighth 4 and a sixteenth 2
conventions.note_cut: gate = written length minus one frame, applied per note on every melodic channel

recipes.name: Power fifth dyad on two pulses
recipes.when_to_use: The default harmony for every riff, chord stab and chorus in this style. This is the chord the style is built on.

params.grid: eighths in a stage theme, sixteenths in a boss theme
params.rearticulate: on every riff attack, never held as a pad

forbidden: a third anywhere inside the dyad
holding the dyad for a full bar as a pad
putting the fifth on the triangle and the root on a pulse

recipes.name: Dotted quarter lean cell
recipes.when_to_use: A stage riff bar that needs swagger rather than speed: one long note that crosses the middle of the bar, answered by a short figure.

params.long_note_semitones: unison or fifth, on the attack
params.placement: bars 1 and 3 of a 4 bar group
params.cut: long note gets the one frame cut like every other note

forbidden: two dotted quarter figures in one bar
a dotted quarter on the last beat of the loop
using it in a boss theme, where the sixteenth surface is the identity

recipes.name: One frame note cut on every melodic note
recipes.when_to_use: Every pulse melody, riff and arpeggio in a Mega Man 1 or 2 style cue, so consecutive notes articulate instead of fusing.

params.consistency: same cut on every instrument in the pattern
params.style_note: Rockman 1 and 2 used this profusely; 4, 5 and 6 deviated

forbidden: cutting some instruments and not others in the same pattern
applying the cut to the triangle bass
using the cut below about 140 bpm, where the gap stops being audible

recipes.name: Volume staircase release
recipes.when_to_use: Any lead note longer than an eighth, so held notes decay like a struck string instead of a square gate.

params.shape: staircase from the attack level down to zero

forbidden: a 1 step decay, which is inaudible on 16 levels
a single linear slide on the pulse volume, which the hardware cannot do
applying the staircase to the triangle, which has no volume control

recipes.name: Duty plan: 25 lead, 50 layer, one change per cue
recipes.when_to_use: Every cue, decided before writing a note. Duty is a voice colour in this style, not an articulation.
forbidden: changing duty mid note
changing duty to sharpen a drum or pluck attack
more than one duty change in a 16 bar loop

recipes.name: Fine detune on any doubled pitch
recipes.when_to_use: Whenever two channels play the same pitch at the same width, including the power fifth octave and any unison doubling.

params.disable_when: the next note differs, so the detune does not smear the melody
params.purpose: prevents the two squares cancelling out of phase

forbidden: doubling a pitch with no detune
detune deeper than 12 cents, which reads as out of tune
detune on the bass root

recipes.name: Delayed echo at 30 to 50 percent
recipes.when_to_use: A stage or boss lead line that needs size without a third melodic voice.
forbidden: echoing a pitch at the same width with no detune, which cancels
echoing the bass line
an echo louder than the lead

recipes.name: Triangle root eighths with an octave jump at the change
recipes.when_to_use: The default bass for any stage or boss riff.

params.octave_jump: last eighth before a chord change
params.volume: fixed, since the triangle has no volume control

forbidden: a bass line with rests in the middle of a riff
a bass walking in sixteenths under a sixteenth melody
bass above MIDI 52, which collides with the pulses

recipes.name: Triangle kick by logarithmic pitch slide
recipes.when_to_use: The Rockman 6 lineage solution when the cue needs a low thud and the noise channel is busy with the snare and hat.
forbidden: a linear pitch slide, which the period table makes impossible
a triangle kick longer than 8 frames
a triangle kick on every beat alongside a noise kick, which double thumps

recipes.name: Noise snare on 2 and 4
recipes.when_to_use: The default backbeat in a stage theme, doubling to all four beats in a boss theme.

params.pitch_hint: the rate index is the starting pitch, so 5 and 9 are the two Rockman snares

forbidden: a snare with no decay, which reads as a hiss
the same snare rate for both the snare and the kick
a snare fill longer than one beat in a 16 bar loop

recipes.name: Hat on eighths, open hat in the B section
recipes.when_to_use: Every stage and boss cue, to make a five channel mix read as a full kit.

params.open_hat: offbeat eighths in section B only

forbidden: hats on sixteenths in a 150 bpm stage theme, which eats the noise channel
open hats in section A, where they blur the riff
hats at the same volume as the snare

recipes.name: One beat fill every 4 and 8 bars
recipes.when_to_use: The bar before every 4 bar and 8 bar boundary in a looping cue.

params.content: snare run then a tom slide
params.landing: on the beat, never a frame early
params.tom: logarithmic falling slide, value 15, then note off
params.skip_at: not every 4 bars in the first 8, to leave the hook clean

forbidden: a fill longer than one beat
a fill in the last bar before the loop seam, which tramples the return
the same fill every 4 bars for a whole 16 bar loop

recipes.name: 16 bar stage loop: 8 plus 8 plus a 2 bar link
recipes.when_to_use: Every stage theme. The measured Mega Man stage cues run 19 to 22 bars, so 16 plus a link is the honest size.

params.A: hook stated, power fifth riff, full kit
params.B: same hook with one operation: sequence, register lift or changed ending
params.link: bass and drums only, or a one bar fill plus a bar of pedal

forbidden: a third section inside an 18 bar loop
a B section with a new melody that never returns
a link longer than 2 bars

recipes.name: 8 bar boss loop, two note riff, no padding
recipes.when_to_use: Every boss cue. The published album timing for the MM2 boss loop is one minute, so this loop is heard several times in a row.

params.drums: snare every beat, eighth hats, kick on 1 and 3
params.tempo: 168 to 190 bpm, faster than the stage it follows
params.harmony: one chord per bar, or a two chord vamp

forbidden: a full melody over a boss loop
a boss theme longer than 16 bars
the same tempo as the stage theme

recipes.name: Stage select figure over a pedal
recipes.when_to_use: The menu cue. It plays while the player chooses, so it must survive dozens of repetitions.
forbidden: a drum kit louder than the figure
a key change mid loop
any note above the melody's octave, which the menu window covers with noise

recipes.name: Game start jingle, two bars
recipes.when_to_use: The cue that plays when a stage begins. The MM2 album timing is eight seconds, so this is two bars at most.

params.mode: major or major with a raised fourth colour
params.channels: pulse1 lead, pulse2 fifth, triangle root
params.drums: one crash on the first beat
params.ends: on the tonic, held two beats

forbidden: a drum pattern under the jingle
a descending shape, which reads as an ending rather than a start
any chromatic note

recipes.name: Stage clear fanfare, four bars
recipes.when_to_use: The cue after a stage boss dies. Seven seconds on the album reference, so four bars.

params.progression: IV, V, I with the I held
params.rhythm: dotted eighth plus sixteenth pickup into each chord
params.drums: snare roll into the final chord, one crash

forbidden: a loop point, since this cue does not loop
a minor cadence
more than three chords

recipes.name: Raised sixth in the B section of a minor stage theme
recipes.when_to_use: The bright dark mixture the series uses to stop a minor stage theme from sounding flat over 18 bars.

params.raise: sixth degree in section B only
params.bars: second half of B, 2 to 4 bars
params.return: natural sixth restored in the link

forbidden: the raised sixth in section A
the raised sixth and the raised seventh in the same bar
using it as a modulation rather than a colour

recipes.name: Relative major section inside a minor stage theme
recipes.when_to_use: A stage theme that needs a released B section without changing tempo or rhythmic cell.

params.mode_change: relative major for the B section
params.transition: one bar of dominant of the relative major
params.return: dominant of the minor in the link bar

forbidden: changing the rhythmic cell at the same time as the mode
a distant key rather than the relative major
a major section longer than the minor one

recipes.name: Hook stated in bars 1 and 2, no intro
recipes.when_to_use: Every stage theme. The style puts the riff on the first beat, because that is what the composers were told to do.

params.identity_feature: one of: rhythmic cell, register lift, one chromatic note
params.seconds_budget: 2.67 s for two bars at 180 bpm

forbidden: a four bar intro before the riff
starting on a pickup with no downbeat
a hook that needs eight bars to complete

recipes.name: Layered inner line on pulse2
recipes.when_to_use: The accompaniment default. Capcom's layering is the documented difference between its sound and Tecmo's.

params.pulse2_role: inner line a third or sixth below the lead
params.doubling: only on chorus bars, and detuned when it happens
params.grid: eighths when the lead moves in sixteenths, quarters when the lead moves in eighths
params.measured_reference: Mega Man melody share 23.6 percent of notes against Ninja Gaiden 35.2 percent

forbidden: pulse2 doubling the lead for a whole section
an inner line that crosses the lead in register
three simultaneous melodic lines on the 2A03, which the chip cannot voice

recipes.name: Pulse call and response one beat apart
recipes.when_to_use: Section A of a stage theme, so the two pulses trade instead of doubling.

params.answer_fills: the rests in the lead line

forbidden: the answer playing while the lead is sounding its main phrase
both voices leaping in the same direction at the same time
an answer that is a literal copy of the lead

recipes.name: Bass led theme, melody sparse above it
recipes.when_to_use: A stage theme whose identity sits in the triangle, the way Heat Man's stage was built on a bass rather than a guitar.

params.bass_pattern: root eighths with a fifth on beat 3
params.melody: one third of the bar at most, or nothing in the first four bars
params.pulse2: power fifth stabs on the bass accents

forbidden: a bass led theme with a busy lead over it
a bass hook that sits above MIDI 52
power chords on every eighth under a bass hook

recipes.name: Arpeggio bass instead of power chords, piano reading
recipes.when_to_use: A quiet stage, a water stage, or any cue that should read as piano rather than guitar, the way Bubble Man's stage was written piano oriented.

params.pulse2: broken chord in eighths, one chord per bar
params.pulse1: stepwise melody, no power fifth layer
params.drums: closed hats and a soft snare, no crash

forbidden: power chord stabs in the same section as the arpeggio
arpeggio and melody in the same register
a noise kick under a piano reading

recipes.name: Two section build with a bridge that subtracts a voice
recipes.when_to_use: A stage theme that has to survive a 30 second loop without fatigue, the Wily Stage 1 shape.

params.bridge: drums or bass drop out for the first half, then climb back
params.return: full texture on the first beat of A
params.published_readings: two sections and a bridge that releases tension; the third Wily cue builds and drops just before the climax

forbidden: a bridge that adds voices instead of removing them
a bridge longer than 4 bars in an 18 bar loop
a bridge with a new melodic idea that never returns

recipes.name: Sampled kick and snare on DPCM
recipes.when_to_use: A cue that wants Tecmo's Ninja Gaiden drum weight: a drum with a real pitch and attack rather than a noise burst.

params.share: one sample channel, so kick and snare alternate

forbidden: sampled hats or toms, which waste the channel
a DPCM kick and a noise kick on the same beat
more than two sampled sounds in one cue

recipes.name: Odd grouping intro figure against a 4/4 body
recipes.when_to_use: An intro or hook that wants to feel off balance for one bar before settling, the DuckTales approach without quoting anything.

params.transcription_note: a fan transcription argues The Moon's intro groups in 15 eighths and that covers smooth it to 4/4

forbidden: an odd grouping that lasts more than two bars
an odd metred drum pattern, which reads as a mistake rather than a hook
more than one odd figure per cue

recipes.name: Ascending arpeggio hook over a descending bass
recipes.when_to_use: The DuckTales kind of hook: the melody climbs while the bass falls, so the cue sounds like a classical figure played by a band.

params.melody: arpeggio rising through the chord, eighths or sixteenths
params.bass: stepwise descent, one pitch per beat
params.drums: none in the intro, closed hats after

forbidden: arpeggio and bass moving in the same direction
power fifth layer under an arpeggio hook
a chromatic bass descent

recipes.name: VRC6 extension: octave, third and saw, melody stays on the 2A03
recipes.when_to_use: Only in our own score, where the seven voice palette exists. Capcom's own releases used no expansion audio, so this is an extension and must not be presented as period accuracy.

params.vrc6_p1: octave of the root, or the third when the cue wants a real triad
params.vrc6_p2: delayed echo or a line a third below
params.vrc6_saw: bass on chorus sections, accumulator rate 32 to 40
params.triangle: kick, tom slide or root pedal
params.voice_budget: at most one addition per section

forbidden: moving the melody to a VRC6 pulse
four simultaneous melodic lines
saw bass and triangle bass on the same root for a whole section

recipes.name: Tempo ladder per cue type
recipes.when_to_use: Whole score planning, so no cue type lands in another's tempo band.

params.floor_note: below 140 the one frame cut stops reading

forbidden: a boss theme slower than its stage theme
a stage theme under 140 bpm with the one frame cut enabled
two adjacent cues in the same tempo band and the same key

recipes.name: One cool set, one cute exception
recipes.when_to_use: Whole score planning. The MM2 director rejected every first draft but one for sounding too cute and asked for cool music, and the cheerful stage survived as the single exception.

params.default_mode: cool: minor, riff led, sixteenth surface
params.exception_role: the cheerful stage or the shop or the bonus cue
params.exception_traits: major, stepwise melody, no power fifth stabs
params.reuse: the exception is never the game's main theme

forbidden: two cheerful cues in the same set
a cheerful cue in a boss or final stage slot
a minor key cue for the designated exception

recipes.name: Loop seam that climbs rather than resolves
recipes.when_to_use: The last bar of any looping stage or boss cue, so the seam reads as a lift instead of a restart.

params.last_bar: root to fifth climb, or a rising chromatic approach
params.drums: keep the kit running through the seam
params.voice_drop: drop the inner line on the last beat
params.evidence: the third Wily cue builds and drops just before the climax so the loop carries the tension

forbidden: a tonic landing on the last bar of a loop
a silent last beat
a fill that ends after the seam

recipes.name: Noise electric hit as a non drum percussion colour
recipes.when_to_use: A texture cue that wants the Quick Man kind of buzz: a percussion sound that is not a drum, used as an accent layer.

params.grid: offbeat eighths or the last sixteenth of a bar

forbidden: an electric hit on the downbeat of bar 1
more than two per bar
using it as the snare
